description: Beta version of ask_pipeworx: identical universal router (same 6,453 tools, same arguments, same response shape) with candidate routing improvements enabled live whenever one is under test. A candidate routing prompt (v9-eval-disjoint-examples) is live on every call here; ask_pipeworx serves it to a slice of traffic only. Use it exactly like ask_pipeworx when you want the newest routing; results are compared against the stable router to decide what merges. Falls back to nothing — this IS a full working router, just the experimental edge.

examples.question: What is the current US unemployment rate?
